subject: harley-calder
label: She had the ring the whole time
from: Held the question from Arc 7 to Arc 11
to: Commissioned the ring in Arc 7 and carried it four arcs
note:
Harley and her parents were part of a government black-ops programme; she was trained from childhood and ranked among the top child assassins. Then she got a little freedom, explored the facility, overheard something, and was dropped at St. Jonah's under one word: FAILED. Assigned 00-101, directly after Evie's 00-100.

She escaped years later after the heebie-jeebies from EDEN, lived off-grid, and was found by Ragnar and James after they watched her kill one of the Hounds they were tracking. In Arc 4 she got tangled in construction rope on the Ghost Haven build and discovered her entire sexuality. In Arc 7's WINTER STORM she worked as a field surgeon in the dark — and asked Bryn for a ring. She then carried it, finished, for four arcs, unable to make her mouth work.
